_doc: The staff talk (docs/city_interiors.md "Staff talk"): topics keyed by act id, shared lists in topic_sets ("@<set>"); the room tones ("Room tones"): tones, tone_by (plot id | unit:<variant> | building type | plot kind); sound_alias: a sound id the soundscape lacks -> an existing one of the same kind. Words in strings/talk.json.

hall_quiet.about: a quiet public hall: soft room tone, a far murmur, a slow wall clock (the cable car station's hall loop)

reading_room.about: a library or a reading room: the hall's hush quieter, now and then a page (diary_page: the wav is in audio/sfx, plays once imported)

cafe_room.about: a café or a canteen: murmur, cutlery, now and then a cup or a plate

bar_room.about: a bar or a dumpling house: the room's murmur over a kitchen through the wall

kitchen_shop.about: a bakery or a pasty bar: the kitchen through the wall, the till now and then

shop_room.about: a shop: quiet, the till's coins now and then

cold_counter.about: a fish shop or an ice-cream freezer: a compressor's hum

empty_room.about: a shut café at night: only the hall's hush, very low

sport_hall.about: a sports hall: a ball bouncing, a whistle (ball_bounce, whistle_short do not exist yet: silent until made)

clock_room.about: a clockmaker's or a keeper's room: ticking (clock_tick does not exist yet: silent until made)

tone_by._doc: first found: the plot id, unit:<variant> (a promenade unit), the building type, the plot kind

sound_alias._doc: an act's sound the soundscape has no pool for -> an existing pool of the same kind (interiors.py writes the alias)
